A usable result must exclude the transient and permanent defects without dropping neighboring valid samples. Earlier review notes recommended combining the two masks; that recommendation was about the required extraction behavior and did not settle a representation or combination API. The generated exposure also has valid pixels that exist in neither mask, so simply rejecting the entire exposure would fail the acceptance example. Keep the viewer's separate counts meaningful while repairing extraction, and judge success from the extracted values as well as the viewer.
